name: Shakti cerebellum session with a project-built ERP pulse ('undo' placement)
summary: A one-coil session just below the bony ridge at the back of the head, after Murphy's Shakti cerebellum page: 20 min of a project-built event-related-potential (ERP) pulse in place of his ERP signal, which he publishes only by name and calls untested. Murphy suggests cerebellar ERP to 'un-do unwanted effects' after sessions that used both the amygdala and the hippocampal signals.
setting: As an 'undo' session after sessions that used both the amygdala and hippocampal signals, or in series that alternate with series over other areas (vendor). Sit, or lie on your side, so the coil at the back of the head is not pressed.
schedule: Vendor: alternate cerebellar series with series over other areas. The vendor's general Shakti rules: at most every 72 h or once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 3 or 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The vendor says its ERP signal is 'derived from a common EEG signature where it represents a cortical response to an event or stimulus' and has 'very low frequencies' ('EVENT-RELATED POTENTIAL SIGNAL'). It offers the signal over the cerebellum to 'un-do unwanted effects', 'as a safety precaution only' ('Bliss', CAUTIONS). Played here: this project's own pulse, not the Shakti file, a 0.6-s waveform built from textbook ERP components (P50, N100, P200, N200, P300) and repeated every 1.5 s on 1-ms points. The shape, the 1.5-s repeat and the 20 min are the project's choice. One coil at Iz. The vendor says 'The Occipital Lobes are above the bony ridge on the back of your head. The Cerebellar vermis is just below it' ('Cerebellum'). Iz lies on the ridge and no 10-5 site lies below it, so the name is the nearest label: seat the coil just below the ridge and check that it sits firmly. Field strength: the vendor gives this signal no field value, only sound-card volume settings, 'approximate values only'. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The default of 1 uT is the project's choice, about 24 uT at the scalp and 56 uT at the coil face. Under the neck muscles the cerebellum lies deeper than 20 mm; by the coil model the field at 40 mm is about a sixth of that at 20 mm. Nobody is reported to have run this session: 'This signal should be considered as untested', and the FAQ says 'The event-related potential signal awaits pilot subjects'. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The modulated 40 Hz form is murphy-shakti-cerebellum-erp-mod40. The vendor warns that 'excess cerebellar activation may lead to emotional flattening', so do not overuse it. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
source: Murphy, Shakti demo: Cerebellum https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/cerebellum.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: ERP signal https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/erp_consent.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Bliss (undo procedures) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/bliss.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Measurement https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/measurement.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Safety - how often https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/how_often_is_safe.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Taking breaks https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/break.htm ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 (8 Coil Shakti amygdala signal, sham-controlled) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
